record.frame: Pollen's mesh frame for upper_leg_right.stl: the left thigh's frame mirrored in x. X = cup depth (open face -42.5, plate inner face -69.5, back face -70.5), Y = width -13.47..34.19, Z = length -12.2..48.8. Servo axes A0 = (y 0, z 0) hip pitch and A1 = (y 22, z 35.777) knee, both along x. The MJCF geom pos (0,0,-42.5) quat (0.5,-0.5,0.5,0.5) places it directly.
